verdict.rationale: The docs mention an 'auto-approve all actions (use with caution)' setting, implying a default mode where actions require manual approval, but there is no explicit documentation of a distinct upfront 'implementation plan' review/approval step before any code changes are made. missing for 10: explicit plan-generation and plan-approval workflow documentation, UI/CLI evidence of a plan-review screen, and independent confirmation that code changes are gated behind plan sign-off.
